## Requirements

1. Live judge binding at `link` through `GatewayModel` (judge profile →
   endpoint), recorded so replay uses `RecordedJudge` byte-identically.
2. Calibration — a declared calibration set (labelled cases from the
   benchset) produces a `CalibrationRecord` per judge; uncalibrated judges
   stay `exploratory` (existing rule).
3. Independence — two judges of different families bound;
   `IndependenceVector` minimums and `RedundantJudge` consumed at
   `link`/gate on these real bindings.
4. Live legs `judge-calibrate`, `judge-run` — calibration over the set + one
   judged run; evidence committed (≤ USD 15; cheapest adequate judges;
   usage→cost recorded; stop-and-ask past allocation).
5. DF-S1.21-3 and DF-S1.21-2 → DONE; ADR-0347/0348/0300/0311 trigger notes;
   BL-17 evidence for R4.16.

## Plan

1. `hh-control` — `JudgePort` gains `assess`/`take_records`/`take_model_io`
   (defaulted — `RecordedJudge` abstains everywhere, replay byte-identical);
   `Driver::drain_judge_records` lands buffered `model_io` +
   `verification.validator.*` rows after the G-INTERPRET consult;
   `completion_gate` folds each `JudgedConsult` through `reconcile_judged`
   per critic ref (uncalibrated consults declined — never a fabricated
   `calibration_ref`).
2. `hh-embed::judge_adapters` — `link_judge` arms a `LiveJudge` over the
   lane's `GatewayModel` (snapshot axis derived + re-based, calibration
   folded, `declare_critic` in full — RedundantJudge / independence /
   GateWithoutCalibration); `link_judged_pair` the different-family pair;
   `calibrate` mints the `CalibrationRecord` over the labelled set.
3. Hermetic tests — `hh-control/tests/r4_7e.rs` (scripted `JudgePort`:
   drain seam, seam-less `model_io` surfacing, per-critic judged
   `claim.reconciled` records, replay abstention) +
   `hh-embed/tests/r4_7e.rs` (loopback `TcpListener` provider: link
   refusals, decided/oracle_failure rows, panel `min`+`withheld`,
   `assess`→`reconcile_judged`, `calibrate` measured agreement, usage
   accounting, replay identity).
4. Live legs — `scripts/live-verify.sh judge-calibrate|judge-run` +
   `crates/hh-embed/tests/r4_7e_live.rs` (`#[ignore]`d, ADR-0363): two
   different-family judges (local + hosted) calibrated over the
   `stage3_v1` benchset labels, then a real `Driver` run whose judged
   `claim.reconciled` rows land — spend ≤ USD 15, `provided` markers
   only.

Live-run substance (WAL read of the passing leg): `judge:live-local.v1`
+ `judge:live-hosted.v1` linked with derived axes
(`different_snapshot_same_family` vs `different_family`); the judged loop
consult minted panel + member `verification.validator.verdict` rows
(`detector:judged`, `calibration_ref` on members, `independence_summary`
durable); the completion gate's `assess` consults minted two
`claim.reconciled{detector:judged}` records — the local critic dissented
(`diverge/censored_evidence` @ 100k ppm — a real judge disagreement on a
real claim), the hosted critic agreed (@ 1M ppm); 5 `hh.model_io/1` blobs
deposited through the fenced seam; `RecordedJudge::from_prefix` replayed
the panel verdict with `has_recording` asserted (the fold was non-trivial —
the recorded answer was 0 ppm, honestly so: neither judge reported loop
evidence on this run).

Honest limits: an earlier leg recorded the local judge's loop-consult as
`oracle_failure` (provider-degraded response — typed, durable, never
converted to confidence); the rerun's local judge decided on both consults.
A failed-leg debit at the declared USD 1 budget per attempt is the spend
ledger's honest conservative accounting (6 failed attempts ≈ USD 6 of the
allocation — retries against the live environment, each producing a
committed failure record before the pass).
